| this | 0x3FC4 | != | 1 | Session phase |

**Guard interpretation:**
- Always: call ThunkToFUN00461480 + FunctionCallWrapper_23e0 to init state.
- Always: set bitfield at offset 0x88 bit 4 = 0.
- Phase != 1 → set bitfield bit 2 = 1.
- Phase == 1 or 2:
  - If slot (v10) == -1: search array via ArraySearchFor1Sentinel, call COM function, call ShortComputation_e5d0 to assign slot.
  - Set bitfield bit 1 = 1 (ready flag).
- Phase not 1 or 2 and a2 == -1: just log.
- Phase not 1 or 2 and a2 != -1: set slot = a2, log.
- Debug logging only when dword_7C569C != 5 (not server).
